description: Parser performance budget fixtures. Every fixture stays inside the upload limits (deploy/ingest-host.env.example and the Pro source-file cap); `prepare` checks that. Paths are relative to this file. Library books: see ATTRIBUTION.md.

fixtures.traits: 19-page two-column research paper: tables, equations, references
42-page lecture deck PDF with 2 scanned pages
277-page prose book: deep headings, boxed examples, outline
104-page technical drawings book: vector line art, some image-only pages
11 pages drawn as thousands of inline images (17,561 on one page): picture triage's per-page matching
384-page worked calculations: stacked fractions, Symbol-font operators, 9.99 MiB (just under the free cap)
610-page figure-heavy textbook, 25.7 MiB (near the Pro cap)
1,016-page LaTeX-built logic text: dense notation, 18 text-less pages
exactly the 1,400-page cap: open-logic followed by waterworks-math
120 image-only pages (grey JPEG, 150 dpi): the OCR stage
62-page generated DOCX: LibreOffice conversion then PDF parse

budgets_note: ci-ubuntu-24.04: slowest of CI runs 38245827044, 38248125967 and 38248138621 (2026-10-12, parser v13) plus 25%; peak_gib is container anonymous memory. Runner speed varied by about 20% between those runs.
